config.discovery: UL001641: first two treated wells per side ordered by SHA256(seed|well); original reference DMSO controls only
config.confirmation: All remaining treated wells; original heldout DMSO wells; original calibration and reference roles preserved
config.candidates: Eight deterministic cells per discovery treated well; ball radii at 5/10/20 percentiles of distances to equally weighted discovery-reference control cells
config.ranking: Equal-well treated occupancy minus control occupancy divided by max(control-well SD,0.02); positive enrichment; highest score primary; up to eight regions with membership Jaccard <0.8 to earlier choices
config.stability: Leave-one-discovery-well-out ranking, excluding that well's anchor candidates; report selected-membership Jaccard on fixed discovery support
config.preprocessing: Reuse original development-reference-only frozen center, isotropic scale, bandwidth, directions and control prototype neighborhoods
config.evaluation_controls: Same calibration and heldout wells with >=100 cells at both budgets; no confirmation outcomes used to select eligibility
config.integer: Exactly N cells without replacement; round(N*f) donor cells; f=1 only if donor has N cells, otherwise record unavailable
config.weighted: Exact empirical treated mass; min(N,donor cell count) donor support cells and N background support cells; not literal integer mixtures
config.backgrounds: Unique original heldout controls per plate/side assigned to confirmation donors by deterministic hash; no well reused across pairs
config.thresholds: Per plate/side empirical 95th percentile of eligible original calibration controls, recalculated identically for all methods and budgets; 80/90 percentile sensitivity only
config.sampling: 20 deterministic without-replacement cell samples for each integer condition; repeats are conditional sampling diagnostics, not biological replicates
config.uncertainty: 2000 plate-stratified bootstrap resamples of physical wells or unique donor/background pairs; conditional on frozen regions and references
config.alignment_diagnostic: Translate each plate/side by its reference-control mean minus the development plate same-side reference mean; no treatment-informed fitting; re-evaluate frozen neighborhoods
config.limitations: Exploratory follow-up using previously evaluated wells; well-disjoint current fitting, not prospectively blinded or independent preparations; repeated treatment columns remain spatially confounded
